about: The live intrusion battery as data: the scenarios, their order and the code each must be answered with. Read by js/live.mjs and by `pact vectors intrude` (crates/pact/src/vectors.rs, through include_str!), each of which builds the envelope for an id and posts it. js/live.test.mjs and the crate's own tests hold both drivers to this file. `twice`: the envelope is posted twice and both answers must be the code. `control`: the one call that must get THROUGH; exactly one, and last, because it leaves the attacker pending on the target. `window_s` is SPEC §13.3's skew window and `margin_s` what a live run adds to it, so the two skew scenarios are well outside the window rather than on its edge.
